instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, eye-level. In an indoor boxing gym with a whiteboard and red pads in the background, the male trainer in a gray t-shirt (R1) stands on the left, back to the camera, holding a focus mitt. The barefoot woman in a blue hoodie (R2) stands on the right on black mats in a boxing stance, looking forward with an open mouth as she recovers from a punch. The woman (R2) faces the trainer (R1) in a ready position. Even overhead gym lighting provides clear visibility and natural tones across the scene.
